summary.text: Argonaut from Achaean Pellene, son of Hyperasius — Apollonius' Asterius, Hyginus' Asterion — or, in Hyginus' other account, son of Antigona, daughter of Pheres, by a father whose name the manuscripts corrupt.

story.text: Apollonius brings him to the muster as Asterius, who came with his brother Amphion, sons of Hyperasius, from Achaean Pellene, which their grandsire Pelles founded. Hyginus calls him Asterion: once with Amphion as a son of Hyperasius (others say of Hippasus) from Pellene, and once as the son of Antigona, daughter of Pheres, from Pellene — though others, he says, make that Asterion a son of Hyperasius from Piresia.
